note: Trigger ids for invalidation items (preprint §5.3). ARP-082 lists the defaults an issued Profile SHOULD carry among the changes that void it; ARP-083 makes platform_baseline_void mandatory for an anchored Profile. Extensions use x_<name>.

terms.meaning: Any change to a model the deployment calls, including its pinned version.
Any change to the harness or its policy configuration (approval workflow, gate policy).
A new or wider operational design domain: use case, data, population, jurisdiction or cost of failure.
A higher-consequence action class becomes reachable, or a prohibited class becomes permitted.
Removal or weakening of a control the claim relies on.
New access (credentials, scopes, entitlements, tools) or a revised accountable owner.
A changed multi-agent topology: agents added or removed, new delegation or communication paths.
The parent Platform Baseline Profile is voided or replaced; an anchored Profile is void if the parent claim is void.
A new version of a cited document or configuration export.
A change with no effect on the claim (formatting, typographical corrections).
